messages:
alex_cheng: Quick async check — where are we on the continuous-batching + KV compatibility smoke for the sprint cut? Need yes/no on rollout gating items.
maria_gonzalez: Running perf harness now against canary. Initial numbers: 12% latency tail reduction, CPU up ~8% on host. I have perf logs in the artifact link: https://ci.redwood/test/4821 :thumbsup:
samir: Thanks. Are those numbers with the new KV prefetch heuristic? Which patch? (PR #8294 or #8330?)
maria_gonzalez: #8330 (adaptive prefetch window). #8294 is the kernel hazard fix — that's merged but not enabled in canary.
jin_park: Quick note: kernel hazard fix + prefetch must land together for correctness on long context. If we enable prefetch without hazard fix we see occasional cache-miss spikes.
olivia_tsai: Who owns enabling the combined flag in deploy? I can do the rollout if infra gives capacity for a canary ring.
alex_cheng: ownership: maria + jin for the flags, olivia to run the canary. infra-bot: Deploy capacity check: canary ring 'sprint-canary-3' has 60% spare GPU headroom — OK for 2h smoke.
maria_gonzalez: I'll queue a perf run with the kernel patch + adaptive prefetch enabled. ETA 40m.
samir: FYI I have an outstanding CR review on #8330 — can someone ping? Need approvals for the prefetch config defaults.
jin_park: on it. I'll review and leave comments; note we should add a small unit test for the handshake edge-case (sequence = 0 fast-path).
olivia_tsai: canary started. Rolling to 10% nodes now. pinging @platform-team for tracing hooks.
platform-oncall: tracing hooks are available at /trace/sprint-canary-3. We'll instrument KV hit/miss ratio and per-token latency.
maria_gonzalez: First 15m: KV hit ratio stable at 0.72, tail latency down ~9%. No error spikes. Uploading sample logs: /artifacts/4975/canary1/logs.txt
samir: noted. I'll re-run the eval harness against the canary responses for quality regression (prompt-set: rnd-1000) — start in 10.
infra-bot: Alert: noticed elevated GC stalls on node 7 (pod 7a) — restarting workload on that pod.
jin_park: Restart expected, nothing to worry about. GC tuning issue we tracked earlier; follow-up ticket ENG-4419.
olivia_tsai: Canary at 50% now. Any blocker to proceed to 100%? 
maria_gonzalez: Two open items: (1) minor kernel log spam when prefetch misses (low severity), (2) Samir's CR must be merged. Otherwise looks green.
samir: Merged #8330 after quick tweak. No further blockers from my side.
alex_cheng: OK — ops plan: olivia to finish roll, maria to monitor perf dashboard for 2h, jin to follow up on log spam fix, samir to add handshake unit test post-merge. If any regressions, fallback to model-variant B (route policy 'fallback-kv-safe') and rollback flags.
maria_gonzalez: Acknowledged. I'll post a follow-up with 2h snapshot. :eyes: 
olivia_tsai: Rolling to 100% now. Will post final status in ~30m.
platform-oncall: Reminder: enable tracing sampling at 20% for production roll to avoid ingest spike.
alex_cheng: Thanks everyone. If anyone hits perf alarms, ping here and #eng-oncall. End of async sync.
